account.value: one canonical raw recipient or derived jetton-wallet address

end_lt.use: inclusive upper LT bound; wire representation of internal beforeLt

offset.reason: LT cursor supplies the next page boundary

pagination.nextBeforeLt: LT of the final new transaction remaining after the exact overlap row is removed
pagination.overlap: for every page after the first, the first row must exactly equal the previous page's final row by account+transaction hash+LT; remove that one row before processing
pagination.cycleUpperLt: LT of the first row from the first page; later rows are deferred to the next cycle
pagination.terminalBoundary: an empty raw page ends the cycle; a page containing only the exact overlap row also ends the cycle because end_lt is inclusive and another identical request cannot make progress
pagination.floorBoundary: after removing the exact overlap, stop before processing rows older than scanFloorTimeMs; reaching the floor ends the cycle
pagination.cursorOnEnd: reset to null according to the recovery contract so a later cycle intentionally rescans bounded history
pagination.regressionRule: pagination_regressed if a non-first non-empty page does not begin with the exact overlap identity, if any retained row has LT greater than or equal to beforeLt, or if retained LTs are not strictly descending; the overlap-only terminal page is endReached, not regression
pagination.providerOffsetPagination: officially supported but not used for the recovery cursor because inserts can shift offsets

responseSchema.transaction.finality: required provider string fact; never sufficient for credit
responseSchema.transaction.in_msg: required non-null object for a mapped candidate
responseSchema.transaction.in_msg.destination: required address string for a mapped candidate

query.selector: exactly one of trace_id, tx_hash, or msg_hash; tx_hash/msg_hash are preferred from a scan candidate

responseSchema.response.traces: required array; exactly one exact selector match for a mapped candidate
responseSchema.trace.transactions_order: required array of standard-base64 transaction hashes
responseSchema.trace.transactions: required object keyed by the same standard-base64 transaction hashes
responseSchema.trace.trace: required non-null tree; every node has tx_hash, in_msg_hash, and children array
responseSchema.trace.trace_info.trace_state: required string and must equal complete for credit
responseSchema.trace.trace_info.pending_messages: required nonnegative integer and must equal zero for credit
responseSchema.transaction.description.compute_ph: nullable object; skipped execution exposes null success/exit_code and a reason string
responseSchema.transaction.description.action: nullable object; when present success and valid are booleans and result_code is integer
responseSchema.message.message_content.decoded: nullable object; only allowlisted decoded fields are retained

responseSchema.response.blocks: required array with exactly one exact-coordinate match

responseSchema.response.last: required block object and treated as latest indexed masterchain head

masterchainInfo.finalityUse: latest indexed head depth is last.seqno minus trace.mc_seqno_end; transaction.finality is not a substitute

query.jetton_address: exact pinned canonical jetton master address

responseSchema.wallet.owner: required non-null address string and must exactly match owner_address
responseSchema.wallet.jetton: required non-null address string and must exactly match jetton_address

jettonWallets.selectionRule: exactly one exact owner+master match is required; zero or multiple exact matches fail closed
jettonWallets.trustBoundary: this is provider-attested indexed lookup, not execution of the master contract get_wallet_address method
jettonWallets.undeployedWalletCaveat: an owner wallet absent from the provider index cannot be derived by this endpoint

normalizationRules.hashes: decode standard base64 strictly to exactly 32 bytes, then encode lowercase 64-character hex; reject malformed, non-canonical, or wrong-length input
normalizationRules.addresses: accept only raw 0:<64 hex> or -1:<64 hex>, then lowercase; no friendly-address inference
normalizationRules.logicalTimesAndAmounts: retain canonical unsigned decimal strings with at most 78 digits
normalizationRules.timestamps: convert provider seconds to safe-integer milliseconds exactly; reject overflow, negative, fractional, or inconsistent values
normalizationRules.opcodes: retain lowercase 0x-prefixed eight-hex strings or null only where the manifest allows null
normalizationRules.messageIndexes: map in_msg to index 0 and out_msgs to their zero-based provider array positions
normalizationRules.externalInputNulls: map null source as null, null value as canonical 0, and null bounced as false only for an external root input whose source, created_lt, and created_at are all null; reject those nulls on internal messages
normalizationRules.executionFlags: description.aborted maps directly; compute_ph.success=true and skipped=false are required for computeSuccess=true; a missing/null action or any action.success/action.valid value other than true maps actionSuccess=false
normalizationRules.traceTransactions: walk transactions_order and look up each exact key in the transactions object; reject missing, extra, duplicate, or reordered identities
normalizationRules.messageLinkage: match every retained output hash to exactly one later input hash and require all mapped message facts to agree
normalizationRules.blockAnchor: join every transaction.block_ref coordinate to one exact /blocks result and attach decoded root_hash, file_hash, and masterchain_block_ref.seqno
normalizationRules.traceCompleteness: require is_incomplete=false, trace_info.trace_state=complete, pending_messages=0, and counts consistent with retained arrays
normalizationRules.decodedPayloadAllowlist: retain only fields needed for text_comment, jetton_transfer, jetton_internal_transfer, and jetton_notify; omit all BOCs, signatures, code, data, and unknown decoded subtrees
normalizationRules.unknownFields: ignore only after the bounded transport has enforced the 1 MiB limit; any required missing or null field fails closed

jettonSuccess.reason: No captured trace satisfied the full policy: the candidate notification recipient transaction was aborted with compute reason no_gas. Provider action success was not promoted over the failed transaction.

gates.nativeFixtureGate: satisfied for manifest and sanitized historical fixture review; no adapter or runtime capability exists in this slice
gates.abortedAndBouncedFailureGate: satisfied by one complete real trace represented by two assertion-focused sanitized fixtures
jettonAutoCreditBlockers: no sanitized full-path jetton success fixture whose complete transaction set is non-emulated, non-aborted, non-bounced, compute-successful, and action-successful
/api/v3/jetton/wallets attests an indexed owner+master mapping but does not execute or cryptographically prove the master contract get_wallet_address derivation
an undeployed recipient jetton wallet cannot be resolved through the indexed wallet lookup
gates.proofClaim: These fixtures prove only the observed sanitized TON Center testnet schema and negative/positive historical shapes. They are not proof of a merchant payment, production readiness, or permission to settle.
